description: Tecno has confirmed that the Camon 50 Ultra 5G will launch in India on July 17 at 12pm IST. An Amazon microsite is now live, revealing the smartphone's design, colour options and AI-focused positioning ahead of its debut. The handset is expected to arrive in Cypress Green, Nebula Titanium and Misty Purple shades. Previously showcased at MWC 2026, the Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G is expected to feature a Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chipset, a 144Hz AMOLED display and triple rear cameras.
title: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G India Launch Date Announced; Colourways and Amazon Availability Confirmed

description: Interpol has traced a cryptocurrency wallet that received more than $122 million over 10 months as part of an alleged romance scam and money laundering network. The investigation, conducted under Operation First Light 2026, led to arrests, the freezing of thousands of bank accounts and crypto wallets, and the recovery of millions of dollars in illicit funds. The case highlights growing international efforts to combat crypto-enabled financial crime.
title: Interpol Traces $122 Million Crypto Wallet Connected to Romance Scam Network

description: Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission has introduced new cybersecurity requirements for crypto trading platforms and online brokers, mandating phishing-resistant authentication methods within 12 months. The new framework bans one-time passwords sent via SMS, email, or apps, replacing them with stronger security measures such as passkeys, hardware security keys, and trusted device authentication. The move comes amid rising phishing attacks and crypto-related cybercrime worldwide.
title: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission Tightens Anti-Phishing Standards for Crypto Platforms

description: Apple may have further reduced production plans for the standard iPhone 17, according to a new leak. A tipster claims some manufacturing lines could suspend around one-third of their capacity after Apple reportedly reassessed demand expectations. The report attributes the move to rising hardware costs, which could affect demand for the entry-level model. Apple has not confirmed the claims. Previous reports also suggested the company had already lowered iPhone 17 production expectations by around 15 percent.
title: Apple Reportedly Reviews iPhone 17 Demand as Costs Rise Amid Ongoing Memory Shortage

description: Motorola has announced the India launch date of the Edge 70 Max and revealed its design along with several key hardware features through a Flipkart microsite. The smartphone will debut in the country on July 15 and will be sold via Flipkart. It is confirmed to feature Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, a Quad HD Plus LTPO 144Hz display, a 7,100mAh battery with 90W wired charging, magnetic wireless charging and an ArcticMesh cooling system.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max India Launch Date Announced; Design, Key Features Revealed

description: Sony RX10 V was launched in the global markets on Thursday as the latest addition to its Cybershot compact camera lineup. As per the company, the fifth-generation model features a ZEISS Vario-Sonnar T* 24-600mm F2.4-4.0 lens with 25x optical zoom. It is paired with a 1.0-type stacked Exmor RS CMOS sensor, powered by Sony’s proprietary BIONZ XR image processor. Sony has also equipped the camera with an AI processing unit for Real-time Recognition autofocus. It supports up to 4K 120fps video recording.
title: Sony RX10 V Compact Camera Launched With 20.1-Megapixel Sensor, 4K 120fps Video Recording and 25x Optical Zoom

description: Itel is gearing up to expand its smartphone portfolio in India with the launch of two new smartphones — Zeno 100 Pro and Zeno 100 Lite. Ahead of launch, the Transsion Holdings-owned company has begun teasing the upcoming handsets through dedicated microsites, revealing some of the key features. Both models are expected to place a strong emphasis on durability. The Itel Zeno 100 Pro is confirmed to feature heat and drop resistance, while the Lite variant is also teased to feature military-grade protection.
title: Itel Zeno 100 Pro India Launch Date Announced as Company Teases Zeno 100 Lite Arrival, Key Features

description: Treyarch has released the PS4 and PS5 ports of Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2. The two games are now available on PlayStation Store, with PS Plus members getting a 50 percent discount for a limited time. Black Ops 1 and 2 originally launched in 2010 and 2012, respectively.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 Ports Released on PS4 and PS5

description: The second week of July 2026 is packed with OTT releases across major platforms. Peddi, starring Ram Charan and Jhanvi Kapoor, is now streaming on Netflix. Ikka brings legal courtroom drama to Netflix. Balti throws some light on a talented kabaddi player. Check out the top OTT releases for this week.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (July 6 - July 12): Peddi, Ikka, Balti, Pati Patni Aur Woh Do, The Westies, and More

description: Asus launched refreshed variants of the Vivobook 14 and Vivobook 15 in India on Friday. The new laptops are powered by up to Intel Core 7 Series 3 processors paired with a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) capable of delivering up to 17 TOPS (trillion operations per second) of AI performance. The Vivobook 14 and Vivobook 15 come with Full-HD IPS displays, up to 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and PCIe 4.0 SSD storage. They run on Windows 11 Home.
title: Asus Vivobook 14, Vivobook 15 Refreshed With Intel Core Series 3 Processors: Price, Availability

description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra could launch in the US with higher prices, according to a recent report. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is tipped to start at $2,099 (roughly Rs. 2,00,300), while Samsung may also introduce a wider foldable model priced at $1,899 (roughly Rs. 1,81,200). The report says the new foldables could debut with One UI 9.0 and Google's Gemini Intelligence. Previous leaks suggest Snapdragon chipsets, upgraded cameras and larger batteries for the upcoming devices.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra Prices Surface Ahead of Unpacked Launch Event

description: Sony has launched the IER-M500 professional in-ear monitor earphones for performers and monitoring applications. The wired earphones feature a 5mm dynamic driver, High Resolution Audio support and a sealed acoustic structure for passive noise isolation. They also include flexible ear hangers, multiple ear tips, fitting supporters and a cable clip for a secure fit. Priced at $119.99 (roughly Rs. 11,500) in the US, the Sony IER-M500 is available for pre-order in Black, Clear and Red and Blue colour options.
title: Sony IER-M500 In-Ear Monitors Launched With 5mm Driver, Hi-Res Audio: Price, Features

description: Vivo T5 Lite 5G will launch in India on July 16 at 12:00pm IST. The official teasers show the phone in light blue and black colour options with a dual rear camera unit. It will be available for purchase through Flipkart. It is confirmed to feature a 6,500mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging. It has a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset include military-grade durability.
title: Vivo T5 Lite 5G India Launch Date Revealed Alongside Key Specifications, Features

description: Apple's first foldable iPhone is expected to launch alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The purported handset, dubbed iPhone Ultra, has surfaced in yet another leak ahead of its anticipated debut. A tipster claims it could feature one of the flattest foldable displays in the industry, with a crease that is barely visible. The Cupertino-based tech giant is said to be evaluating two different manufacturing approaches to achieve this.
title: Apple's iPhone Ultra Tipped to Feature Near Crease-Free Foldable Display Using Novel Hinge Technology

description: Bitcoin traded above $63,000 on Friday as easing geopolitical tensions and lower oil prices supported market sentiment. Analysts, however, cautioned that rising Treasury yields, uneven ETF demand, and the upcoming options expiry could keep volatility elevated. Investors are also awaiting key US inflation data for fresh direction.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $63,800 as Lower Oil Prices Lift Crypto Market Sentiment

description: Meta Platforms on Thursday announced Muse Spark 1.1 as its latest multimodal reasoning model designed for agentic AI tasks. The company claims it brings significant improvements over its predecessor when it comes to tool use, coding, computer interaction, and multimodal reasoning. Developed by Meta Superintelligence Labs, the AI model supports a context window of up to one million tokens. Alongside, Meta also released a public preview of the new Meta Model API for developers.
title: Meta Unveils Muse Spark 1.1 AI Model With 1 Million-Token Context Window, Model API Preview

description: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced launched on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on July 9. The game has already become the series' biggest launch on Steam, reaching nearly 100,000 peak concurrent players on the storefront. Black Flag Resynced is a full remake of Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Becomes Biggest Steam Launch in Series' History

description: Oppo Find N7 will reportedly be launched in the first quarter of 2027. The next-generation foldable is said to be undergoing testing with the 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (SM8950). It could come with a 6,500mAh battery. The Oppo Find N6 has a 6,000mAh battery with 80W wired and 50W wireless charging support.
title: Oppo Find N7 Leak Hints at Launch Timeline and Presence of 6,500mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Chip

description: The government has removed import duties of 7.5% and 5% on selected components used in mobile phones and other electronic products, benefiting firms such as Apple and Xiaomi. The exemption, valid until 31 March 2029, covers wireless charging parts, displays and lithium-ion cells. The move is expected to improve competitiveness, encourage local manufacturing and battery production, and support India’s electronics growth ambitions.
title: Government Removes Import Duty on Some Electronics, Smartphone Parts
Laptops for Students in 2026: Top Picks for Every Category

description: HMD has reportedly launched the HMD Arc 2 in Thailand as the successor to the HMD Arc from 2024. According to a report, the smartphone is powered by a Unisoc T603 chipset, replacing the older SC9863A. It features a 6.52-inch HD+ 60Hz display, Android 14 Go Edition, up to 128GB storage, a 13-megapixel rear camera and a 5,000mAh battery with 10W charging. The handset is expected to go on sale in Thailand from July 20.
title: HMD Arc 2 Launched With Unisoc T603 Chip, 5,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Vivo X Fold 6 has just appeared on an Indonesian certification site, suggesting that the global launch will happen soon. The listing shows the phone with model number V2559. It was launched in China last month with an 8.02-inch AMOLED inner display and a 6.51-inch cover screen. It has IP58 + IP59 ratings for dust and water resistance. The handset runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super chipset.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Reportedly Gets Indonesian SDPPI Approval; May Arrive in Global Markets Soon

description: iPhone 18 Pro Max could be significantly more expensive to manufacture compared to its predecessor. The handset, which could be joined by the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, is expected to debut at Apple’s September event. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to confirm any details, a market research firm has analysed its estimated cost of components. Overall, the highest storage variant of the iPhone 18 Pro Max could be approximately $300 (roughly Rs. 28,600) more expensive than its predecessor.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Component Cost Could Jump Nearly $300 Over iPhone 17 Pro Max: Report

description: Netflix appears to be quietly bringing back one of its most popular sign-up benefits. In recent days, several users across the world have reported receiving a complimentary subscription to the streaming service when signing up for a new account. The move, which has already been confirmed by the company, comes almost six years after Netflix stopped offering free trials, allowing new users to explore its catalogue of films and shows.
title: Netflix for Free? Some Users Are Getting a 30-Day Trial Subscription Offer: Here’s How to Check
